Goal: make the outbound request timeout configurable.

1. Follow exactly the same style the loader already uses for its other settings (same parsing/coercion/default mechanism, same struct/field or dict/key idiom). Do not invent a new configuration mechanism.
3. Make the client actually use that configured value as its request timeout instead of any hard-coded or implicit timeout. Thread it through the same way other config values already reach the client.
4. Add a test that covers the new behaviour, in the existing test file/suite that matches this area, using the repository's existing test style: assert the default is 30 when the setting is absent, and that an explicitly provided value is honoured and reaches the client.
